thread:
maya: Quick sync — we need to lock the convo endpoint shape for the Q2 launch. Primary asks: messages vs prompt, strong system role enforcement for enterprises, function/tool calling integration, and structured output. What should we prioritize?
alex: Messages-first for API parity with other LLMs. Enables role metadata and tool calling flow. :thumbsup:
sam: Messages-first is clearer but adds payload bloat for tiny single-turn calls. Our infra saw ~6-10% increased token count in some microbenchmarks.
jordan: From model side, roles are useful for few-shot control. But we measured a perf delta when we pass large role metadata every request — need caching or prefix token reuse.
priya: Customer asks we heard: 1) pin a system role that can't be overridden by users, 2) audit log of system/user messages, 3) ability to require structured output (json schema) for integrations.
kevin: UX thought: offer a single endpoint that accepts either `prompt` OR `messages`. Server-normalizes to a canonical `messages` form. Keep examples tiny in SDKs.
alex: Dual-accept mode is appealing, but docs + SDKs become a support burden. Migration/compatibility will be the pain point.
maya: Proposal: accept both for the launch, but mark `prompt` as legacy-ish and auto-normalize on the server. Launch criteria: docs, SDK examples, migration guide, canary rollout, and a way to opt-in to system-role enforcement.
sam: Implementation note: normalization layer can convert `prompt` -> `messages` by creating a user message. Should also support a `role_overrides` flag for restricted accounts.
jordan: Also need to define canonical role names and semantics: `system` = global instructions (trusted), `user` = user input, `assistant` = model outputs. Document how handlers like function-calling interact with roles.
kevin: Suggest short example in docs:```json
{"messages": [{"role": "system", "content": "You are a concise assistant."},
{"role": "user", "content": "Summarize sales deck."}],
"functions": [{"name": "summarize", "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"length": {"type": "string"}}}}]}
```
priya: Enterprise ask: system message must be lockable via org policy and surfaced in audit events. Also want a flag `require_structured_response` that triggers schema-checking/auto-retry on the model.
maya: Launch checklist (short): docs + migration guide, SDK parity, admin controls for system role, structured-output validation, perf benchmarks, and rollback plan. Any missing hard blockers?
alex: One more: function calling contract — we should specify whether the assistant can call functions from system or only user messages can trigger. Need to decide default.
jordan: Default: allow tool calls from assistant generation path but prefer user-initiated triggers. We'll document options: `allow_system_tool_calls: true|false` at API request level.
sam: Performance mitigation: implement prefix caching for pinned system role per org — avoids re-sending whole system prompt each request.
kevin: Docs + examples should show minimal `prompt` -> `messages` mapping and a migration snippet in each SDK. Keep snippet under ~10 lines.
maya: Can we get eng owners to estimate work and a canary schedule? Sam/jordan?
sam: I'll do an initial estimate today. Plan: normalization + prefix cache + admin flag = 2-3 sprints.
jordan: I'll own model contract doc for function-calling interactions and role semantics. Draft by EOW.
priya: I'll pull the top 5 enterprise asks and sample legal/compliance wording for audit logs.
deploy-bot: canary: convo-shape-normalization v0.1 deployed to staging — monitor traces and token counts. :rocket:
maya: Great. I'll schedule a 30m check-in for Monday and add this to the roadmap doc. Meeting invite: https://calendar.internal/meet/convoshape. Thanks everyone.
